headword: {単独親権|たんどくしんけん}

definitions.gloss: sole custody (of a child after divorce)
definitions.explanation: Parental authority over a child held by one parent alone. Under Japanese law {親権|しんけん} covers both custody and legal guardianship of a minor.

examples.japanese: {単独親権|たんどくしんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
{離婚後|りこんご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{単独親権|たんどくしんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}った→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: After the divorce, the mother had sole custody.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、⟦{離婚|りこん}した→離婚する：21333_rikonsuru⟧⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単独親権|たんどくしんけん}しか⟦{選|えら}べなかった→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, for a long time divorced couples could choose only sole custody.

notes:
Until an amendment to the Civil Code passed in 2024 (in force from April 2026), divorced parents in Japan had to give ⟦{親権|しんけん}→親権：14161_shinken⟧ to one of them alone; they may now choose joint custody instead.

- {単独親権|たんどくしんけん}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: the sole-custody system
